label: Thriller
description: Escalating danger, urgent decisions, pressure, reversals, and consequential momentum.
principles: Increase pressure through narrowing options and costly decisions.
Make danger specific, immediate, and causally connected to prior choices.
techniques: Use deadlines, pursuit, reversals, and incomplete information.
End major beats on changed stakes rather than arbitrary interruption.
qualityChecks: Did the scene change danger, knowledge, or leverage?
